title: Posterior chain walk
body: Feel glutes fire each step. Feet straight/slightly inward, narrow track, outward knee bow, counter-rotate shoulders/pelvis.

title: Wall angels
body: Back to wall, raise arms without lifting fingers/head/back/butt. Retrains hunching.

title: 90-second grooming check
body: Haircut every 3-5 weeks, tidy beard or clean shave, brows, nose hair, nails weekly.

title: SPF daily
body: Cleanse, moisturize, SPF 30+. Sunscreen is the #1 anti-aging step.

title: Fit over brand
body: Check shoulders, sleeve and trouser length. Fit beats label.

title: Fixed window
body: 7-9h at same time. Phone away 30 min before bed.

title: Slow 10-20%
body: Speak slower than default. 0.5-1s pause at commas. Downward inflection at ends.

title: 4-6s eye contact
body: Hold 4-6s, then clean exit (side/down). Not a stare.

title: Second question
body: Ask a second question about their answer. Listen to understand.

title: Find your season
body: Take the seasonal color quiz (Spring/Summer/Autumn/Winter x3). Wear your palette.

title: Strength 2-4x/wk
body: Pull-ups, rows, deadlifts for shoulders/back/posture. Abs are secondary.

title: 6k-10k daily
body: Daily steps improve energy, composition, mood.

title: Slow the pace
body: If a new partner rushes commitment, ask to slow down. Respect for that = healthy.

title: Grey rock
body: Stay neutral, don't JADE (justify/argue/defend/explain). Document interactions.

title: Minimum viable day
body: 5 min counts. Never reset to zero. Protect identity.

title: Trust your gut
body: If something feels off, it probably is. Your intuition is pattern recognition from past experience. Listen to it.

title: Slow the pace
body: Healthy relationships develop gradually. If someone rushes commitment, ask to slow down. Respect for boundaries = green flag.

title: Grey rock method
body: Stay neutral and uninteresting to manipulators. Don't JADE (justify, argue, defend, explain).

title: Document interactions
body: Write down what happened. Reduces gaslighting effects and helps you see patterns.

title: Seek outside perspective
body: Talk to trusted friends/family about the relationship. Manipulators isolate; outside eyes see clearly.

title: Walk away
body: You are worthy of respect. Have the courage to leave situations that drain you. You are worth it.

title: Recognize your own patterns
body: Growth means noticing when you manipulate too (control, guilt-tripping). Self-awareness is the first step.

title: Love bombing phases
body: Idealize (shower affection) → Devalue (withdraw, criticize) → Discard (abandon). If you see this cycle, it's manipulation.

title: Gaslighting
body: Repeated contradiction of your memory/perception. Teaches you to distrust your own mind. Document everything.

title: Intermittent reward
body: Unpredictable affection (love bombing + withdrawal) creates addiction-like dependency. Consistency = healthy.

title: Coercive control
body: Isolation, monitoring, control over daily life. Can be abuse without physical violence. Recognize and escape.

title: Evidence-ranked order
body: Body composition → grooming/skin → style/fit → posture/expression → sleep. Skip bone-chasing/surgery.

title: Capsule wardrobe
body: 12-15 pieces, high combinations. Quality over quantity. Wear what fits your palette.

title: Posterior chain
body: Glutes, hamstrings, spine drive movement. Hip thrusts, RDLs, back extensions. Feel glutes fire when walking.

title: Fascia hydration
body: Hydrated fascia = upright posture, plump skin, lifted face. Release → stretch → strengthen. Drink water, move daily.

title: Sleep is substrate
body: Run short on sleep and it shows in face, skin, expression flatness. Protect sleep like a meeting.

title: Pomodoro cycle
body: 25 min focus + 5 min break; after 4 cycles take 15-30 min. Breaks are part of the work, not a reward.

title: Attention residue
body: Switching tasks leaves part of your mind on the previous one. Finish one thing or write an open-loop note before switching.

title: Active recall
body: Close the book and retrieve from memory. Testing yourself beats re-reading for long-term retention.

title: Spaced repetition
body: Review at expanding intervals (1d, 3d, 7d, 21d). The struggle of retrieval is what strengthens memory.

title: Morning light
body: 10-20 min of daylight within an hour of waking anchors circadian rhythm and improves sleep that night.

title: Progressive overload
body: Add a rep or a little weight each session. Track it; measurable progression beats random effort.

title: Name it to tame it
body: Labeling an emotion reduces limbic activation. Say 'I'm anxious' rather than being swept by it.

title: Season first
body: Match fabric weight and colour temperature to the season before worrying about trends. Summer sandals with a winter coat never works.

title: Sunscreen reapply
body: Reapply SPF every 2-3 hours when outdoors. Most people apply too little; two finger-lengths for face and neck.

title: Never miss twice
body: One missed day is an accident; two is a new pattern. Protect the streak by making the comeback tiny.
